assertions.description: getComputedStyle preserves object-fit and object-position declarations on <object> and <embed> elements.
assertions.test: (() => { const obj = document.createElement('object'); const emb = document.createElement('embed'); obj.style.objectFit = 'none'; obj.style.objectPosition = '80% 20%'; emb.style.objectFit = 'cover'; document.body.append(obj, emb); const ok = getComputedStyle(obj).objectFit === 'none' && getComputedStyle(emb).objectFit === 'cover'; obj.remove(); emb.remove(); return ok; })()

assertions.description: An <object> sized 240x160 loading an intrinsic 120x80 SVG document with object-fit: none renders the inner SVG at scale 1.0 (unscaled 120x80 concrete object size) rather than stretching 2.0x across the 240x160 content box.
assertions.test: (async () => { const svg = '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="120" height="80" viewBox="0 0 120 80"><rect width="120" height="80" fill="royalblue"/></svg>'; const obj = document.createElement('object'); obj.type = 'image/svg+xml'; obj.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:-9999px;top:0;width:240px;height:160px;object-fit:none;object-position:50% 50%;border:0;padding:0;'; obj.data = 'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,' + encodeURIComponent(svg); document.body.appendChild(obj); await new Promise((resolve) => { obj.onload = resolve; setTimeout(resolve, 400); }); const ctm = obj.contentDocument?.documentElement?.getScreenCTM?.(); obj.remove(); if (!ctm) return false; return Math.abs(ctm.a - 1) < 0.05 && Math.abs(ctm.d - 1) < 0.05; })()
